name: Pane Manager
author: Sebastian Webber
description: Manage tiled panes from the bar: resize them by dragging the divider with your mouse, set the border thickness and corner style, and put a mangled layout back the way it was.

barWidget.description: Drag-the-border pane resizing, border thickness and corner style, and one-click layout reset for the current workspace or all of them. Left click opens the panel.

schema.label: Grab area
schema.description: Pixels beyond the drawn border that still count as the resize handle (Hyprland's general:extend_border_grab_area). Larger is easier to grab; too large starts stealing clicks near a pane's edges.

schema.label: Round corner radius
schema.description: Corner radius in px applied when Corners is set to Round (Hyprland's decoration:rounding).

schema.label: Max border thickness
schema.description: Upper bound of the border thickness field.
